purpose: Fixed controlled-input extrapolation challenge for the unchanged D46.5 candidate; calibration inputs are generated separately and no training is claimed.
color_space: sRGB, embedded frozen ICC profile; pixel arithmetic is in sRGB code values, not scene-linear radiance

noise.filter: Periodic full-canvas FFT Gaussian exp(-2*pi^2*sigma^2*(fx^2+fy^2)); DC fixed to zero; divide by the analytic RMS filter gain, never a measured per-image standard deviation
noise.composition: Each scale combines sqrt(.65)*shared + sqrt(.35)*independent channel fields, then sums the three stated amplitudes around code value 128, clips to [0,255] and uses numpy.rint once

dots.centers: Independent continuous uniform draws on the full half-open canvas [0,750) x [0,1334), without rejection for position, overlap, Dock location or resulting appearance
dots.palette_assignment: For each scale, integer index modulo six, then a seed-controlled permutation; positions and colors have no Dock-dependent selection
dots.polarity: Rec.709 weighted sRGB code value relative to background 128; this is a source-code contrast label, not physical luminance
dots.shape: Ideal hard circular disks, sigma=null; exact membership at 4x4 subpixel sample centers followed by BOX area averaging, coarse then medium then fine source-over
dots.overlap_policy: Keep and label every source point including overlaps and edge clipping. Save overlap IDs and final raster RGB at its center. Do not regenerate difficult inputs.

precommitted_controls: Freeze protocol, generator, ICC bytes and dependency versions before generating the registered images.
Use every predeclared seed; never select seeds, points, crops or frequencies by native/Android captured appearance.
Do not inspect test captures to tune the current candidate. This batch tests extrapolation only.
Calibration inputs are not holdout and generation is not evidence of completed calibration or training.
All three scales are mixed across the full canvas; no quadrant or Dock-specific point placement.
Test and calibration share a declared design but have disjoint seeds. This is seed independence, not design blindness or a representative natural-scene sample.
tracking_contract: Use known source point positions, sizes, colors, overlap records and local constellations; retain the source identity when evidence supports correspondence.
Allow zero, one or multiple observed lobes per source point, as well as fusion, occlusion, clipping and unresolved ambiguity.
Do not force nearest-neighbor matches or assign a displacement to a point without supported correspondence.
Record search support, confidence, residual, competing candidates and rejection reason; use cross-correlation where individual dots are unresolved.
Cross-correlation and point tracking have different resolution/robustness limits. Neither uniquely identifies native thickness, refractive index, blur or its rendering implementation.

primary_method_reference.title: A Dot-Tracking Methodology for Background-Oriented Schlieren (BOS)
primary_method_reference.scope: Motivates known dot-position/size priors and retaining a distinction between dot tracking and correlation. No fluid-diagnostic physical model is assumed for a UI renderer.
